# Tracing

Write diagnostic output, which the run reports apart from ordinary console output.

**Library:** [Standard library](index.md#standard-library), for apps and code-pipeline hooks. More in [Cogniscript](../../../concepts/cogniscript.md).

| Call | What it does |
|---|---|
| [`Trace`](#trace) | Writes diagnostic text to the run's console, without a line break. |
| [`TraceLine`](#traceline) | Writes diagnostic text to the run's console, followed by a line break. |

### Trace

Writes diagnostic text to the run's console, without a line break.

```c
void Trace(string text)
```

| Name | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `text` | `string` | The text to write. |

Each call adds one entry to the run's console output (`consoleOutputs` on the run), marked as trace output (type `Trace`), so readers can tell it apart from ordinary output written by [`Print`](console.md#print) and [`PrintLine`](console.md#printline). Use [`TraceLine`](#traceline) to end the text with a line break.

### TraceLine

Writes diagnostic text to the run's console, followed by a line break.

```c
void TraceLine(string text)
```

| Name | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `text` | `string` | The text to write. |

Each call adds one entry to the run's console output (`consoleOutputs` on the run), marked as trace output (type [`Trace`](#trace)) so readers can tell it apart from ordinary output written by [`PrintLine`](console.md#printline); the entry's text ends with the line break.
